records.part: Assays and controls to perform HIV-1/HIV-2 Supplemental differentiation testing and Newborn Screening Sickle Cell tests
records.reason: The Geenius™ System is the only FDA approved HIV-1/HIV-2 differential assay currently on the U.S. market and has been validated in-house for the confirmation of HIV-1 Oral Fluid meeting the guidelines required.
